faq.a: Abdulhameed is associated with Arabic. Abdulhameed is Arabic عَبْدُ الْحَمِيد (ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd), meaning 'servant of the Praiseworthy'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ الْحَمِيد is Arabic.
